**Şadi Evren Şeker** is an Assistant Professor of Instruction in Computer Science at The University of Texas at Dallas, where he teaches CS 2V95, *AI for All: Career-Ready AI Skills*, a course open to students in every major with no prerequisites. This book parallels the course's fifteen weeks. [AUTHOR NOTE: degrees, fields, institutions and years, if you want them listed.]

He has worked in artificial intelligence and machine learning for more than 25 years. Earlier in his career, he served as a dean and as a department chair and was an associate professor of management information systems. [AUTHOR NOTE: institutions and years for each role, or remove.]

His published work includes research on a computerized argument Delphi technique (*IEEE Access*, 2015), a study of large language models in software development (*Electrica*, 2026), and many Turkish-language entries in *YBS Ansiklopedi*. He develops HermAI, an open-source Python package for hermeneutic explainable AI, and holds four patents. [AUTHOR NOTE: confirm the patent count and whether to name them.] He also runs the *Bilgisayar Kavramları* (Computer Concepts) YouTube channel. [AUTHOR NOTE: add an audience figure only if you want one; project notes from October 2026 give about 284,000–286,000 subscribers.]

He is a founder of OptiWisdom, which develops Compass, this book's optional digital companion, and software for businesses, including AI tools ("How This Book Was Written" declares this interest). [AUTHOR NOTE: corporate training and project work, if you want it mentioned; city of residence; a personal line.]
